mapper.select:
select ipv.P_Id as pId, mn.Ims_Cumulative_Inv as imsCumulativeInv, mn.Ims_Img_Progress as imsImgProgress, mn.Ims_Month as imsMonth from Inv_Monthly_Schedule mn left join Inv_Plan_Year ipv on ipv.Ipv_Id=mn.Ipv_Id where ipv.Ipv_Declare_Year=#{year} and mn.Ims_Month <= #{month} and ipv.P_Id in
#{pId}

select ipv.Ipv_Declare_Year as ipvDeclareYear, mn.* from Inv_Monthly_Schedule mn left join Inv_Plan_Year ipv on ipv.Ipv_Id=mn.Ipv_Id where mn.ipv_Id in
#{ipvId}

select mn.* from Inv_Monthly_Schedule mn left join Inv_Plan_Year ipv on ipv.Ipv_Id=mn.Ipv_Id where ipv.P_Id = #{pId} and mn.Ims_Month = #{gfpMonth} and ipv.Ipv_Declare_Year = #{gfpYear} and ipv.Ipv_State = 7
select ims.* from Inv_Monthly_Schedule ims where ims.ipv_id=#{ipvId}

choose.when: and mn.Ipv_State = 7 and mn.Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy') and cast(to_char(now(), 'mm') as int) >= ims.Ims_Month
and mn.Ipv_State = 7 and mn.Ipv_Declare_Year = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') and cast(date_format(now(), '%c') as unsigned) >= ims.Ims_Month
